charts.title: Brent crude
charts.subtitle: EIA Europe Brent spot via FRED. Persistent closes above $100 are the V1 oil stress gate.

charts.title: US 10-year yield
charts.subtitle: Treasury constant-maturity 10-year yield, in percent. V1 watches a sustained break above 4.82%.

charts.title: Near-term SOFR vs current FOMC target
charts.subtitle: Atlanta Fed Market Probability Tracker: probability that 3-month average SOFR finishes above the current target range. This is not CME FedWatch meeting odds.

charts.title: Next FOMC meeting odds
charts.subtitle: Polymarket prices for the next scheduled Fed Decision event. This is a prediction-market price, not CME FedWatch and not Atlanta Fed SOFR odds.

charts.title: CBOE VIX
charts.subtitle: Daily CBOE Volatility Index via FRED. This is the raw VIX level, not the credit/VIX sync-stress rule.

charts.title: CNN Fear & Greed
charts.subtitle: CNN Business US-equity Fear & Greed Index (0=extreme fear, 100=extreme greed). Not Alternative.me crypto sentiment. Public history is about one year.

charts.title: High-yield OAS and VIX
charts.subtitle: ICE BofA US High Yield OAS and CBOE VIX. Sync stress requires both 5-day changes positive and both 20-day z-scores above +1 on a shared date.

charts.title: Cross-asset performance context
charts.subtitle: Existing market-monitor index closes reused as context, not as a second price store.

charts.title: US Treasury yield curve
charts.subtitle: Latest published constant-maturity yields versus one week ago, one month ago and the start of the year. Missing tenors stay blank; the chart does not interpolate.
